dataset: 10M x 128 original FP32, one CAGRA shard built from the same stress export
note: Warm isolated worker round-trip latency. Not SQL QPS. Historical commands retain node paths.
validation: CPU/reference suite and 24 GPU tests passed, including native FP32 on/off, four-shard distance/filter/order checks, and mislabeled graph rejection.
caveats: Completion of the benchmark does not enforce a recall target. Inspect request means and individual query recalls.
Single 15-repeat runs, grouped by worker mode rather than randomized interleaving; speed differences need repeated runs to establish significance.
4,096 frontier without extra candidates failed 95% mean recall on some broad cases. Larger frontier alone did not fix it.
The 4,096 frontier plus 256 extra candidates run reached at least 95% mean recall across its 12 native points. Lowest individual query recall was 53.8%.
All pipelines use the same graph and configured candidate budgets within a run; approximate multi-CTA traversal can vary between executions.
v5 planner/worker calibration remains FP16-specific and was not retuned for native FP32.
The final datatype validation is loader-only and was added after timing collection; the measured search path is unchanged.
